properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Wall thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: BoxLength
properties.description: Casing length along the duct. 0 uses twice the duct size

properties.name: BoxWidth
properties.description: Casing width. 0 uses 1.5 times the duct size

properties.name: BoxHeight
properties.description: Casing height. 0 uses 1.5 times the duct size

properties.name: CollarLength
properties.description: Length of the inlet and outlet collars. 0 uses a quarter of the duct size

properties.name: CleanPressureDrop
properties.description: Pressure drop in Pa of a clean filter at the design flow (a typical value: replace with the maker's data)

properties.name: FinalPressureDrop
properties.description: Pressure drop in Pa at which the filter is changed (a typical value: replace with the maker's data)

properties.name: FilterCondition
properties.description: Which pressure drop the analysis uses: clean, final, or halfway between them (mid-life)
